verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator: it generates simulated sensor data and runs simulations locally or on remote servers. Capturing telemetry on a physical robot and syncing it to the cloud under bandwidth-aware policies belongs to robot fleet and data-platform tooling, so this axis is outside a simulator's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo shipping on-robot capture or cloud sync; gz-transport messaging is only a developer building block and would not flip the axis.
